Rahul Roy
Rudolph Peierls Centre for Theoretical Physics,
1Keble Road,Oxford,OX1 3NP,UK
(Dated: 13 January 2010)
We provide an argument based on fux insertion to show that certain superconductors with a
non-trivial topological invariant have protected zero modes in their vortex cores.This argument
has the flavor of a two dimensional index theorem and applies to disordered systems as well. It
also provides a new way of understanding the zero modes in the vortex cores of a spinless pz + ipy
superconductor. Applying this approach to superconductors with and without time reversal and
spin rotational symmetry, we predict the necessary and sufficient conditions for protected zero modes
to exist in their vortices.
